## Change

Explain the user-visible behavior or research question. Identify reused modules.

## Verification

Exact commands, results, and any checks not run:

## Evidence and boundaries

- [ ] Claims distinguish supplied code, explicit teaching, inferred behavior and measured results.
- [ ] Previous captures, checkpoints, closed splits and unrelated changes are preserved.
- [ ] No new experiment is implied by a documentation or engineering check.
- [ ] Private sessions, credentials and large binaries are excluded.
- [ ] Protocol/config and result commits are separate if evaluation was authorized.
- [ ] Main merges require explicit approval.

## Limitations

Record negative/inconclusive outcomes, missing data and remaining risks.
